msc_rationale: Finite model theory: rank-three Ehrenfeucht–Fraïssé equivalence and induced-substructure optimality for finite relational structures in a linear-order signature.
scientific_integrity: The 70-letter baseline is credited to Mwesigye and Truss. The new 73-letter word is verified by an exact 62196-case exhaustive computation, supplied as reproducible C++ source; a distinct Python implementation corroborates its fingerprints and sampled cases.
scientific_limitations: An explicit 73-letter counterexample is proved; 73 is not claimed as the smallest counterexample length. No all-parameter classification or extension to higher ranks is established. No independent external audit has been conducted.
title: A rank-three coloured order with no optimal induced suborder
